text.en:
Transfer of PPI from DOH to DTI. The PPI shall be transferred
from DOH to DTI to improve policy and program coordination relative to the
Government's procurement and importation of drugs and medicines under RA 9502.
Office ofthe
• Brosident of the Philingines

Repealing Clause. All executive issuances or portions thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked, amended, or
modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
upon publication in a newspaper of general publication.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 6th day of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Eleven.
September , in the year of
